# Bartosz Frąckowiak

> Solution Architect with 12+ years of experience in distributed systems, domain-driven design, and AI-native engineering. Leads an AI transformation across several hundred developers. Writes weekly essays on software architecture, the people around it, and the corporate machine they form together. Offers architecture consulting, architecture training, and Generative AI / Claude Code training. Based in Poland, available worldwide.

Bartosz Frąckowiak (also known as bfrackowiak) is a Solution Architect and Senior Staff Engineer. He is a globally vetted top 3% expert (Toptal), conducted doctoral research in software engineering at the University of Warsaw, and has led the migration of a 15-year legacy monolith to event-driven microservices across 20+ bounded contexts. Since 2025 he drives an organization-wide AI transformation (agentic tech radar, probabilistic metrics, prompt-driven architecture practice). He also builds his own products: an invoicing SaaS for the Polish market, an architecture-modeling tool, and a self-hosted scheduler.

## Blog: Field Notes

Weekly essays on software architecture, the people around it, and organizational systems.

For LLM ingestion: the complete blog content in one plain-text file is at https://bfrackowiak.pl/llms-full.txt, and every essay has a raw markdown mirror at its canonical URL plus `index.md` (e.g. https://bfrackowiak.pl/blog/mathematicians-vs-lawyers/index.md). The RSS feed at https://bfrackowiak.pl/feed.xml carries full article HTML.

## Services

### Software Architecture Consulting
Strategic architecture reviews, system design advisory, and hands-on guidance for complex technical decisions. Includes architecture audits and health checks, system design for new products, microservices and distributed systems guidance, and decision-rights governance (ADRs, RAPID).

### Software Architecture Training
Workshops and mentoring programs on Software Architecture, System Design, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS/ES patterns, API and integration design, and Architecture Decision Records.

### Generative AI & Claude Code Training
Training grounded in leading a real AI transformation across several hundred developers: Claude Code mastery, agentic workflow design, spec- and prompt-driven development, and AI-assisted architecture and code review.

## Expertise

- Software Architecture & System Design

- Cloud Architecture (Azure)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is Bartosz Frąckowiak?**
A Solution Architect with 12+ years of experience and doctoral research in software engineering behind him, based in Poland. He designs distributed systems, leads an AI transformation across several hundred developers, writes weekly essays at https://bfrackowiak.pl/blog/, and offers consulting and training worldwide.

**What does he write about?**
Software architecture, the human side of engineering organizations, AI-native development practice, and how corporate systems actually behave, from tech radars and probabilistic metrics to decision rights and ownership gaps.

**What services does he offer?**
Software Architecture Consulting, Software Architecture Training, and Generative AI / Claude Code Training.

**Is he available for remote work?**
Yes. Based in Poland, working with clients worldwide, remotely and on-site.
